tools.name: get_clausepilot_payment_info
tools.description: Returns the ClausePilot flagship paid contract-risk API URL, price, network and x402 payment protocol without charging.

tools.name: list_clausepilot_paid_tools
tools.description: Lists the ClausePilot flagship API plus all focused Agent Store tools, including price and endpoint, without charging.

tools.name: analyze_contract_risk
tools.description: Paid $0.05 USDC contract workflow analysis. Without paymentSignature it returns the x402 payment challenge; retry after payment to receive the analysis.

tools.name: extract_renewal_deadline
tools.description: Paid $0.015 USDC tool that extracts term, expiry, auto-renewal and notice-window signals from contract text.

tools.name: find_contract_penalties
tools.description: Paid $0.015 USDC tool that finds early termination fees, liquidated damages, late fees and similar exposure.

tools.name: extract_contract_obligations
tools.description: Paid $0.02 USDC tool that extracts operational obligations such as reporting, security, SLA, audit and insurance duties.

tools.name: summarize_contract_for_agents
tools.description: Paid $0.02 USDC tool that produces a compact structured contract summary for downstream agents and workflows.

tools.name: triage_contract
tools.description: Paid $0.08 USDC bundle that returns contract summary, renewal timing, penalties, obligations and payment terms in one call.

tools.name: triage_pdf_contract
tools.description: Paid $0.12 USDC tool for text-based PDFs. Extracts up to 30 pages and returns bundled contract triage. Invalid or image-only PDFs are rejected before settlement.

tools.name: triage_contract_batch_10
tools.description: Paid $0.69 USDC portfolio tool for up to 10 contracts with per-contract triage and portfolio-level ranking.

tools.name: scan_contract_portfolio_50
tools.description: Paid $3.49 USDC portfolio scan for up to 50 contracts with ranked risk, renewal, penalty, obligation and payment-term summaries.

tools.name: scan_contract_portfolio_200
tools.description: Paid $12.90 USDC high-volume portfolio scan for up to 200 contracts with ranked operational triage.

tools.name: compare_contract_risk
tools.description: Paid $0.06 USDC tool that compares two contracts across renewal, notice, penalties and operational risk signals.

tools.name: review_vendor_contract_risk
tools.description: Paid $0.05 USDC tool that reviews vendor contracts for renewal, lock-in, service, data, liability and commercial risk signals.

tools.name: check_saas_terms
tools.description: Paid $0.04 USDC tool that checks SaaS terms for suspension, unilateral changes, data, SLA, renewal and liability signals.

tools.name: check_nda_clauses
tools.description: Paid $0.04 USDC tool that extracts confidentiality scope, duration, exclusions, residuals, return/destruction and related NDA clauses.

tools.name: extract_employment_terms
tools.description: Paid $0.04 USDC tool that extracts employment terms without making jurisdiction-specific legal conclusions.

tools.name: extract_payment_terms
tools.description: Paid $0.02 USDC tool that extracts payment timing, invoicing, late fees, currency, billing cycle and discount signals.
